text:
Maya (Mktg): Need a tight visual kit for next week's webinar on inference economics. Request: 3 hero panels (1200x628, 800x800, 1920x1080), two lightweight process diagrams (routing + fallback), a 1-page SDR crib sheet, and a 15-20s animated slide showing fallback. First-pass by Tue morning pls.

Ravi (Design): On it. Can someone paste exact headline + stat? I have a design block Mon morning.

Lena (Product Marketing): Headline: "Predictable inference economics: latency you can budget for". Stat: "~2.3x cost reduction vs naive serving with batching + KV cache (internal benchmark)". CTA: "Configuration guide + live demo".

Maya (Mktg): Figma: https://figma.com/redwood/inference-kit (view). Drop into /marketing/assets.

Ravi (Design): Diagram style? swimlane for motion or stacked cards for static?

Tom (Webinar): Swimlane please; easier to animate. Add 3 sparkline callouts (baseline, batched+cache, dedicated). Need hover/callout copy.

Lena (Product Marketing): Callouts: 
- Baseline: "single-request, no batching — higher unit cost"
- Batched + cache: "batching + KV cache — lower cost, similar latency"
- Dedicated: "reserved capacity — predictable latency & throughput"

Nora (Legal): Legal note: include footnote exactly: "Internal benchmark on representative test workload; actual results vary by model and traffic patterns." Then I can sign off.

Ravi (Design): Plan: PNG mockups Tue 9:30AM, animated spec Tue 4PM. Will push to Figma and tag @Maya @Tom. If anyone wants a live review, I have a 30m slot Tue 10.

FigBot: Comment added on /marketing/assets/diagrams/seq1: "need routing lane labels"

Maya (Mktg): Routing labels: "ingest → policy-router → model-pool → fallback". Owners: Ravi (design), Lena (copy), Nora (legal), Tom (webinar). Thanks! :rocket:
